answer: In this PoA design, bonded escrows make each identity costly, while correlated equivocation by k coordinated identities triggers penalties that scale quadratically, O(k²), rather than as isolated violations. A detected sybil swarm also faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss, so splitting control across identities compounds downside instead of diluting it. Whether nodes gather at zephyr, knoll, or dune, shared evidence links their actions and exposes the full coalition to slashing.
